assignments.why: A benchmark of coding-agent tasks measuring test exploitation (verifier failures), built by generating adversarial 'impossible' variants of existing test sets.
A GRPO-trained reward model whose judging is agentic: it plans tool calls to gather evidence before verifying responses.
A benchmark scoring LLM user simulators' realism and proxy validity against real users, with profile conditioning, for multi-turn assistant evaluation.

assignments.note: 2025-10 TIR-Judge Tool-Integrated RL for LLM Judges
assignments.why: End-to-end RL training of reasoning judges that call a code executor while judging in pointwise, pairwise and listwise formats.
A process reward model trained with TD/GAE labels that scores multi-turn agent trajectories step by step.

topics: team theory and distributed decision making
assignments.why: A controlled study of multi-agent debate with verifiable ground truth, finding majority pressure suppresses correction, i.e. consensus dynamics among agents sharing an objective.
A multimodal generative reward model trained with RL to use tools while judging.
A judge that refines its own evaluation meta-prompt from self-generated feedback as it judges, updating only where it was self-inconsistent.
Measures Jev's accuracy and calibration (ECE vs AURC) on Indonesian regional languages and tests cascades that route its least confident decisions to a fallback model.
A survey whose subject is agentic evaluators, organised by stages of agency and capability dimensions.
An agent explores the repository to write a grounded rubric and scores SWE-agent patches with it, an agentic judge design.
A training recipe (cross-entropy on the decision token inside GRPO) that makes an open reasoning classifier's single-token probability calibrated, measured by ECE with isotonic stacking.
Continuous-score computerized adaptive testing with a ranker that stops once adjacent model pairs are confidently ordered.
Measures how rewritten agent chain-of-thought fools trajectory-reading VLM judges (adversarial cues) and tests prompt-based judge mitigations.
A human study on tau-bench retail measuring the fidelity of LLM-simulated users as proxies in agentic evaluation.
A hypothesis-testing framework that uses a human calibration set to estimate an imperfect judge's TPR/FPR (judging the judge) and keep valid error control when certifying failure rates.
A benchmark of 89 containerised terminal tasks for agents with test-based outcome verification.
A tool-augmented verifier agent for GUI agent trajectories that escalates from cheap evidence extraction to expensive live-environment probing only when needed.
A teacher agent generates problems that get harder as the student solves them, so the test set co-evolves with the model under test.
Automated discovery of unknown LLM-judge biases, producing the generated meta-evaluation set JudgeBench-Pro on which strong judges exceed 50% error.
A tool-using agentic evaluator with metrics for scoring deep-research agents' reports.
LoRA-fine-tuned small-LM judges that answer in one token with a logit confidence, a recipe for single-pass decision judges from open backbones.

assignments.note: 2026-02 Outcome Accuracy is Not Enough Rationale Consistency
assignments.why: Trains generative reward models with a rationale-consistency plus outcome reward and uses them for RLHF on pairwise preference benchmarks.
Measures how rubric judges' scores shift with score-option position and criterion order, and reduces it with random permutations.

assignments.note: 2026-02 SCOPE selective conformal optimized pairwise LLM judging
assignments.why: Pairwise judges abstain under a conformally calibrated threshold to bound error, with uncertainty scored by querying both answer orders.

assignments.note: 2026-02 Scaling Agentic Verifier for Competitive Coding
assignments.why: An agentic verifier that discriminates among candidate competitive-programming solutions, an execution-based verification setting.

assignments.note: 2026-02 Why we no longer evaluate SWE-bench Verified
assignments.why: An audit of an agent benchmark finding flawed tests (verifier failures) and contamination, leading to its retirement.
Regression testing for stochastic agents with Wald's SPRT and confidence-interval verdicts to minimise trials, plus trace fingerprints as a testing harness.
A meta-evaluation benchmark measuring how well LLM judges detect and localise perturbed reasoning errors.
A test LLM trained adversarially to write tests that expose a code LLM's defects, with a Mistake Book replaying past failures.
